industry.structure: U.S. dialysis is concentrated among a few national chains (DaVita, Fresenius) with high fixed-cost centers and payer-negotiated reimbursement; entry requires capital, licenses, and nephrologist relationships.
industry.share_shift: DaVita remains the largest U.S. provider by revenue; share shifts are slow and driven by center openings/closures and hospital partnerships rather than disruptive new entrants.
industry.trend: Aging population supports treatment volumes; Medicare and MA rate changes, labor costs, and value-based care pilots are the active industry variables in 2025–2026.
